description: Change a QR code without reprinting it. target_url re-points it (not for table codes, which always open their table). label renames it. retired: true takes it out of use — its printed QR then opens the menu, and the code stays reserved; retired: false restores it. A printed code is never deleted. Find codes with list_qr_codes.
name: update_qr_code
title: Update qr code
